CustomField.description: Ordered list of fallback Google Drive folder identification (ID) values, separated by ";". Files are uploaded to the "Default Google Upload Folder Id" first; when that folder exceeds its capacity limits (for example, a shared drive reaches its item cap), the system automatically retries the upload using the next folder identification (ID) in this list, in order, until one succeeds.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ordered list of fallback Google Drive folder identification (ID) values, separated by ";". Used only when the primary "Default Google Upload Folder Id" cannot accept more uploads. Leave blank to keep the current single-folder behavior.
CustomField.label: Additional Google Upload Folder Ids
